app.name: Timers
app.summary: A kitchen timer you set with +10s, +1m, +10m and +1h, and a stopwatch with laps.
app.setting_opens: Open the timer when it is done
app.setting_opens_hint: A timer on the screen opens its card when the time is up, whatever page shows.
app.part_sound: Ring when a timer is done
app.part_sound_hint: Three beeps every two seconds for a minute, or until you tap Stop. Follows the screen's volume.
app.setting_sound_hint: The beeps when a timer is done, on a screen with a speaker. They follow the screen's volume.
